build_tree_grower: build a TreeGrower from binned input data, gradients, and hessians with configurable max_leaf_nodes and max_depth
grow_regression_tree: grow a regression tree using best-first split strategy based on gradients and hessians of training data
split_tree_node: split the tree node with highest gain into left and right child nodes respecting constraints
create_tree_predictor: create a TreePredictor from a grown tree using binning thresholds for fast inference
create_tree_node: create a TreeNode with depth, sample indices, partition bounds, gradients, and hessians for tree building
